usage: agentware fanout spin-up [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--base BASE]
                                [--kb-base KB_BASE] [--repo REPO]
                                [--kb-repo KB_REPO] [--dry-run]
                                features [features ...]

positional arguments:
  features              feature slug(s)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --base BASE           package base ref for feat/<f> (default: HEAD)
  --kb-base KB_BASE     KB base ref for kb/<f> (default: --base)
  --repo REPO           package repo (default: this agentware repo)
  --kb-repo KB_REPO     KB repo (default: the resolved knowledge dir)
  --dry-run             print the plan; write nothing
